image_description: A slice of layered chocolate cake on a white plate, accompanied by two scoops of vanilla ice cream. The cake features dark chocolate sponge layers and a lighter caramel or mousse filling. It is topped with a dollop of whipped cream and a thin, curved shard of chocolate garnish. A small red berry sits in the foreground. Dark chocolate sauce is drizzled over the side of the cake and pools slightly on the plate.

Standard depth-of-field blur, but the transition between the sharp cake and the blurred background is slightly soft/haloed, typical of AI generation, though not severe.
